template.title: 1. Download the template
template.explanation: Write one homework per row. Do not change the header row, and delete example row 2.

columns.class: The name of a class that exists in the current academic year, e.g. Class 5.
columns.section: A section of that class, e.g. A.
columns.subject: A subject name that already exists, e.g. Mathematics.
columns.due_date: Year-month-day, e.g. 2026-10-05. It cannot be before the date given.
columns.description: A short note about the task. You can leave it empty.
